structured_output.summary: The SNAP household is the three listed people. Their only income is $17,100 of self-employment earnings, or $1,425 a month. Under 7 CFR 273.10(e)(1) the 20% earned-income deduction ($285) and the FY2026 standard deduction ($209) leave net income of $931. Thirty percent of that is $279.30, which must be rounded to a whole dollar under 273.10(e)(2)(ii)(A), so the allotment is $785 − $280 = $505 a month, or $6,060 a year. The engine follows exactly these steps and uses the FY2026 amounts published before the freeze for all 12 months, which matches stage 1. The consensus of $6,068.40 leaves out the required whole-dollar rounding.
